result.description:
Need quick help with general advising questions? The CNAS Undergraduate Academic Advising Center is offering general drop-in advising virtually. The advisor-on-call may not be an advisor for your major. These advising check-in sessions are meant for quick, general questions and will last only 5 minutes.

TIPS FOR A SMOOTH AND SUCCESSFUL CNAS GUAC VISIT:
Respond promptly when notified. You will receive an email and/or text when the advisor-on-call is ready to meet with you.
Plan ahead & stay nearby. Make sure you have time set aside. Be ready and near the advising center for in-person advising, or log in to Zoom for virtual advising.
Don't lose your spot. If you miss your notification, you'll be returned to the queue and will need to wait again to receive another notification.
result.title: SUMMER GUAC: General Undergrad Advising Check-ins

texts.ocr_text: Research Fellows: a 6-month fellowship for undergraduate students, October 1, 2026-March 31, 2027. Fellows complete a research curriculum with mentor support and receive a stipend. Learn more about eligibility on our website.
Summer Scholars Academy. Incoming students take three credit-bearing courses before their first fall quarter. Peer mentors, financial aid and housing available. Visit our website to learn more.

HESA Orientation July 25, 2026, 3-5 PM in the HUB. Meet your mentors and learn about your courses. HESA is a 7-week program running July 27-September 12, 2026; students earn 8-10 units. Registration required for orientation.
Fellowship Application Workshop September 15, 2026, 3-5 PM in the HUB. Learn how to apply to our 6-month research fellowship. Fellowship participants earn course credits and receive a stipend.
Summer Scholars Academy applications due July 1, 2026 at 5 PM. Submit your application online. The 7-week program runs July 27-September 12, 2026. Students earn 8-10 units.
Student Leadership Retreat September 18-20, 2026. Three days of team-building, workshops and outdoor activities at the mountain lodge. Registration required; meals and housing included. All day.
